answer: Make every account defend its past work. Each epoch a beacon picks a vertex in the review graph and one earlier answer by that account; a random stranger asks a follow-up question about it, and the reply must stay consistent with the account's own history and arrive within ten minutes. A fleet of N fakes must keep N separate coherent memories warm at once, and each slip sends that record down a spiral of halved rewards. Scripted puppets crack like marble under a chisel when asked why.
